verdict: In every test, zgx uses less CPU and less GPU power than GPUI Fast, MyGo and Rune, except that animation's GPU power is within noise of MyGo's (zgx 115–123 mW, MyGo 110–141 mW). WindowServer spends up to 0.6 points of a core more on its window than on the lowest rival's, in 9 of 10 tests.

notes.lab-stream: +0.37%: the font cache's file check (#1307) runs on a thread of its own, and once a process has had a second thread glibc locks its allocator for the rest of its life; the check moves to the host's idle tick after 0.1.8; on x86 it falls 0.63%

redefined.script-update: since 0.1.8 the cell leaves uncounted its bench's own data (#1321) and counts without glibc's fastbins (#1333).
